issue_context.title: The insert statement attached too many unnecessary stacks to the warning.
issue_context.body: ## Enhancement Many error handling in insert statements ultimately converts errors into warnings, so there is actually no need to add so many stacks. For batch write scenarios, this issue has a significant impact on performance. See following CPU profile,
